# THTH

> THTH is a human-approval gate for LLM-drafted public posts (Threads,
> Bluesky, Mastodon). The agent drafts, a human approves, the tool posts and
> records everything in your git. Nothing leaves your machine unless you
> opt in.

## Docs

- [README.en.md](README.en.md): what it guarantees, refuses, and never does; install; daily flow; every real CLI command
- [docs/usage.en.md](docs/usage.en.md): day-to-day usage — topics, queueing, two-step approval, troubleshooting
- [docs/導入_自分のMetaアプリで動かす.md](docs/導入_自分のMetaアプリで動かす.md) (Japanese): first-time Threads setup with your own Meta app
- [docs/導入_Bluesky_2026-09-13.md](docs/導入_Bluesky_2026-09-13.md) (Japanese): first-time Bluesky account setup
- [docs/導入_Mastodon_2026-09-13.md](docs/導入_Mastodon_2026-09-13.md) (Japanese): first-time Mastodon account setup
- [thth.me](https://thth.me): project home
